name: The Breakfast Klub
tagline: Houston's legendary breakfast institution famous for catfish and grits since 2001.
description: Houston's most beloved breakfast institution, The Breakfast Klub has been welcoming long lines of loyal regulars since 2001. Famous for catfish and grits, chicken and waffles, and an unwavering commitment to Southern breakfast perfection that has made it a Houston landmark.

name: Lucille's Houston
tagline: Nationally acclaimed Southern restaurant honoring great-grandmother Lucille B. Smith's culinary legacy.
description: Named for chef Chris Williams' great-great-grandmother Lucille B. Smith, this nationally acclaimed restaurant serves elevated Southern cuisine with deep historical roots. A Midtown Houston dining landmark celebrated for innovative takes on African American food traditions.

name: Burns Original BBQ
tagline: Houston BBQ institution serving slow-smoked Texas tradition since 1973.
description: A Houston BBQ institution since 1973, Burns Original has been smoking brisket, ribs, and sausage low and slow for generations of loyal customers. One of the city's most authentic and enduring pitmaster traditions, still going strong after 50 years.

name: Gatlin's BBQ
tagline: Houston craft BBQ pioneer bringing award-winning brisket and community love to Garden Oaks.
description: Greg Gatlin's Garden Oaks craft BBQ restaurant has earned a devoted following and national recognition for its carefully smoked brisket, ribs, and Southern sides. A hometown Houston success story built one perfect plate at a time.
address_line_1: 3510 Ella Blvd Bldg C Ste A

name: ChòpnBlọk
tagline: James Beard-nominated West African street food bringing jollof and jerk to Downtown Houston.
description: James Beard-nominated Nigerian-American chef Ope Amosu's Downtown Houston restaurant bringing West African street food — jollof rice, suya, and jerk chicken — to the heart of Texas. One of Houston's most celebrated and boldly original dining destinations.

name: Kulture Houston
tagline: Southern meets African-Caribbean fusion in Downtown Houston's vibrant arts district.
description: An upscale restaurant in Houston's arts district celebrating African-Caribbean and Southern culinary traditions with artfully prepared dishes and craft cocktails. Kulture has become a premier destination for Houston's culture-forward dining scene.
address_line_1: 701 Avenida De Las Americas Suite A

name: Triple J's Smokehouse
tagline: Trinity Gardens BBQ gem famous for boudin, loaded potatoes, and pure Texas soul.
description: A neighborhood gem in Trinity Gardens serving some of Houston's most beloved BBQ alongside loaded baked potatoes, boudin, and homestyle sides. Triple J's is the kind of place that becomes a family tradition passed from generation to generation.

name: Salon Meyerland
tagline: Houston's premier Black hair salon suite with 74 expert stylists under one roof.
description: One of Houston's largest and most established Black hair salon suites, with over 70 independent stylists under one roof serving all hair types and textures. A destination for anyone seeking expert natural hair care, extensions, color, or protective styles in Southwest Houston.

name: TRENDZ by Tammy
tagline: Natural and relaxed Black hair salon specializing in silk press, locs, and pixie cuts.
description: Houston's trusted natural and relaxed hair salon specializing in silk presses, locs, braids, and pixie cuts. Known for healthy hair practices and a welcoming atmosphere that keeps clients coming back for every appointment.

name: TWT Fitness
tagline: Women-only fitness studio built on community, accountability, and real transformation.
description: A women-only fitness studio in the Houston area built entirely on community, accountability, and real transformation. TWT creates an encouraging environment where women of all fitness levels feel safe, supported, and motivated to reach their goals.

name: McConnell & Jones LLP
tagline: America's largest African American-owned CPA firm delivering audit, tax, and advisory services.
description: America's largest African American-owned CPA firm, providing audit, tax, and advisory services to corporations, nonprofits, and government entities since 1987. McConnell & Jones has earned national recognition for excellence in public accounting and a commitment to diverse leadership.

name: Jimerson Advisory Group
tagline: Black woman-owned CPA firm providing expert tax and financial guidance to Houston businesses.
description: A Black woman-owned CPA and financial advisory firm providing expert tax planning, business consulting, and financial guidance to Houston's entrepreneurs and small businesses. Trusted by clients who want a financial partner who truly understands their goals and their community.

name: Five Star Social Media Agency
tagline: Black-owned digital marketing agency growing Houston brands through bold social strategies.
description: A Houston-based Black-owned digital marketing agency helping businesses grow their brands through bold social media strategy, content creation, and community management. Known for delivering real, measurable growth for clients across multiple industries.

name: Houston Small Business Marketing
tagline: Black-owned agency helping Houston small businesses grow their digital presence and reach.
description: A full-service Black-owned marketing agency helping Houston small businesses build their digital presence through SEO, social media, and targeted advertising. Dedicated to making sophisticated marketing strategies accessible for businesses of every size.

name: The Ensemble Theatre
tagline: Houston's professional Black theatre company producing powerful African American stories since 1976.
description: Houston's only professional theater company dedicated to producing works by and about the African American experience, operating since 1976. The Ensemble has brought hundreds of productions to Houston stages, earning national recognition for artistic excellence and community service.

name: Blackacre Builders
tagline: Black-owned Houston homebuilder crafting quality custom homes in Independence Heights.
description: A Black-owned Houston homebuilder crafting quality custom homes with close attention to detail and deep community investment. Specializing in new construction in Independence Heights and surrounding Houston neighborhoods.

name: The Beauty Vault HTX
tagline: Houston's Black-owned beauty supply store stocking curated products for textured hair.
description: Houston's go-to Black-owned beauty supply store carrying a carefully curated selection of products for textured, natural, and protective styles. A one-stop shop stocking the products Black women in Houston actually need, without wading through products that weren't made for them.

name: Kindred Stories
tagline: Third Ward bookstore spotlighting Black and POC authors across fiction and nonfiction.
description: A Black woman-owned independent bookstore that curates contemporary and classic Black literature and hosts book clubs, author talks, and community workshops. It is located inside the Eldorado Ballroom in Houston's historic Third Ward.

name: CLASS Bookstore
tagline: Family-operated Black-owned bookstore next to Texas Southern University.
description: A Black-owned, family-operated bookstore located near the Texas Southern University campus. The store maintains a free bookshelf so cost is not a barrier to accessing Black authors.

name: Three Keys Coffee
tagline: Award-winning Black-owned craft coffee roastery inspired by jazz and travel.
description: A Black-owned craft coffee roastery with flavors inspired by jazz music and travel, operating a solar-powered roastery on Foster Street.

name: Day 6 Coffee Co.
tagline: Black-owned coffee shop serving specialty lattes and pastries in Houston.
description: A Black-owned coffee shop serving specialty lattes, breakfast sandwiches, and pastries. It features local art and showcases other small-business products.

name: Reggae Hut Cafe
tagline: Longstanding Black-owned Caribbean cafe in Houston's historic Third Ward.
description: A Black-owned Caribbean restaurant in Houston's Third Ward known for jerk chicken, curried goat, oxtails, and Jamaican patties. It is a longstanding neighborhood staple on Almeda Road.

name: Navy Blue
tagline: Upscale Black-owned seafood restaurant in Rice Village.
description: An upscale Black-owned seafood restaurant in the Rice Village area featuring a contemporary seafood menu.

name: Cool Runnings Jamaican Grill
tagline: Black-owned Jamaican grill serving Caribbean comfort food in Houston.
description: A Black-owned Caribbean restaurant serving Jamaican dishes in southwest Houston.

name: Ray's BBQ Shack
tagline: Black-owned barbecue spot serving Texas smoked meats in Houston.
description: A Black-owned barbecue restaurant serving Texas-style smoked meats, located on Old Spanish Trail.

name: Thrive Juices
tagline: Black-owned smoothie and juice bar inside POST Houston.
description: A Black-owned smoothie and juice bar located inside POST Houston downtown.

name: Feeling Juicy
tagline: Black- and millennial-owned juice bar in Houston's historic Fifth Ward.
description: A Black- and millennial-owned juice bar described as the first juice bar in Houston's historic Fifth Ward, with a mission to help combat local food deserts.

name: Pressed Roots
tagline: Salon dedicated to silk presses and styling for textured hair.
description: A Black woman-owned salon that focuses on silk presses and natural styling for textured hair, offering a streamlined, spa-like experience. Its Houston location is on Westheimer Road.

name: A Vibe Called Hair
tagline: Black-owned Houston salon focused on a calm, welcoming hair experience.
description: A Black-owned hair salon offering top-tier services in a calm, welcoming environment.

name: The Plant Project
tagline: Texas's first Black woman-owned plant shop, with a Houston Heights location.
description: A plant boutique described as Texas's first Black woman-owned plant shop. Its Houston location is at M-K-T Heights.

name: Gite Gallery
tagline: Third Ward gallery specializing in sub-Saharan and West African art.
description: A Black-owned art gallery in Houston's Third Ward specializing in art from sub-Saharan and West Africa including paintings, sculptures, masks, textiles, and furniture.

name: Premium Goods
tagline: Houston's pioneering Black woman-owned sneaker boutique in Rice Village.
description: A sneaker and streetwear boutique founded by Houston native Jennifer Ford, widely cited as the first Black woman-owned sneaker retailer in the U.S. Located in Rice Village, it carries major and Black-owned labels.

name: Llulo
tagline: Africa-inspired fashion and lifestyle brand using traditional Ankara fabrics.
description: An Africa-inspired fashion and lifestyle brand founded by a Houstonian, using traditional Ankara fabrics for apparel and home goods.

name: Wonderlikewander
tagline: Black-owned Midtown brand blending apparel, coffee, art, and event space.
description: A Black-owned multidimensional brand in Midtown offering apparel, gifts, coffee, visual arts, and a creative event space for communal experiences.

name: Guillory Candle Co.
tagline: Woman-owned Houston candle brand using coconut soy wax and essential oils.
description: A woman-owned candle company offering eco-friendly candles handcrafted with coconut soy wax and essential oils, free of paraffin, phthalates, and dyes. It also offers wax melts, room sprays, and plant-based body products.

name: Simply Scents Candle Co.
tagline: Black woman-owned scented candle company based in Houston.
description: A Black woman-owned candle company based in Houston focused on scented candles, located on Almeda Road.

name: The Butter Bar Skincare
tagline: Black-owned skincare brand making hand-crafted products with simple ingredients.
description: A Black-owned skincare brand creating hand-crafted skincare products with recognizable, simple ingredients.

name: Core & Soul Studio
tagline: Black-owned Houston studio offering yoga and pilates with a holistic focus.
description: A Black-owned wellness studio emphasizing holistic health through mindfulness, balance, and flexibility, offering yoga and pilates classes. It is located on West Cavalcade Street.

name: Elite Dental Wellness
tagline: Black woman-owned Houston dental office with an all-Black-women doctor team.
description: A Black woman-owned dental practice noted for its all-Black-women doctor team. It is located on Westheimer Road in Houston.

name: Hermann Park Smiles
tagline: Black-owned dental practice in Houston's Medical Center / Museum District.
description: A Black-owned dental practice in Houston's Medical Center and Museum District area.

name: CB Agency
tagline: Black-owned creative marketing and public relations agency in Houston.
description: A creative marketing and public relations agency based in Houston specializing in creative design, production, and media relations.

name: Hooker CPA Firm, PLLC
tagline: Black-owned Houston CPA firm offering accounting and tax services.
description: A Black-owned CPA firm providing accounting and tax services in Houston.

name: Sneed & Mitchell LLP
tagline: Black-owned Houston personal injury law firm.
description: A Black-owned law firm focused on personal injury cases, operating in Houston, Texas.

name: GigEasy
tagline: Black-founded Houston insurtech platform for gig-economy workers.
description: A Black-founded insurtech startup based in Houston offering flexible health, dental, and vision coverage for gig-economy workers and businesses, including an API for integration.

name: Source Vital Apothecary + Beauty Market
tagline: Houston skincare boutique and apothecary featured among Black-owned beauty brands.
description: A Houston skincare boutique and apothecary offering natural skincare and beauty products.

tagline: Bun B's smash-burger sensation, voted best burger in America.
description: Co-founded by Houston rap legend Bun B, Trill Burgers grew from a viral food-truck smash burger into one of the city's most beloved Black-owned restaurants. Known for its signature OG smash burger, it has expanded to several Houston-area locations since 2021.
name: Trill Burgers

tagline: Houston's legendary Creole fried chicken institution since 1969.
description: Founded by New Orleans native Percy 'Frenchy' Creuzot, Frenchy's Chicken has served Houston its signature Creole-seasoned fried chicken, red beans, and dirty rice since 1969 — a Third Ward-born institution and one of the city's most enduring Black-owned restaurants.
name: Frenchy's Chicken

tagline: Family-owned Cajun and soul food on North Shepherd since 2008.
description: Esther's Cajun Café & Soul Food blends a father's soul food with a mother's Cajun roots into one of Houston's favorite Black-owned, family-operated kitchens. Established in 2008, it's known for gumbo, fried catfish, and hearty Southern comfort plates.
name: Esther's Cajun Café & Soul Food

tagline: Third Ward soul food carrying on a beloved Houston legacy.
description: Run by the family of late founder Jeanette Williams, Mikki's Soul Food Cafe serves Southern classics from the historic Third Ward storefront on Blodgett — a Black-owned kitchen continuing a generations-deep Houston soul food tradition.
name: Mikki's Soul Food Cafe

tagline: Museum District vegan-friendly brunch, coffee, and good vibes.
description: Born from the Houston Sauce Co. food truck, Mo' Brunch and Brews is a Black-owned Museum District café known for craveable vegan and traditional brunch plates, specialty coffee, and a community-first atmosphere.
name: Mo' Brunch and Brews

tagline: Historic Third Ward plant-based café built around community.
description: Doshi House is a Black-owned café in Houston’s Historic Third Ward where community is built over coffee, tea, and plant-based victuals — a welcoming gathering place rooted in sustainable, compassionate hospitality.
name: Doshi House
